comparison_class.definition: Names with positive 30-day EPS revision momentum and a four-quarter history of consistent, non-trivial positive earnings surprises
comparison_class.why_this_class: closest analogue rewarding revision momentum and a repeated beat pattern over the raw consensus level

thesis: EPS estimates were revised up 3.4% over the trailing 30 days -- clear positive momentum -- and the last four quarters all beat by a meaningful margin (2.1% to 7.8%), not a single lucky quarter. Guidance last quarter also came in above the then-consensus. Price-target dispersion is moderate, not extreme, suggesting reasonable analyst agreement rather than a confused consensus.
what_would_change_my_mind: A reversal to negative revision momentum, or a surprise miss breaking the beat pattern.
